comment: Curated, pipeline-facing flow groups. Hand-maintained: these ids are stable and safe to reference from workflows, docs, and bookmarks. Spec-level and describe-level flows are discovered automatically by scripts/test-runner/discover-flows.js and do not belong here.

groups.name: Sanity smoke
groups.description: Fastest confidence check. One smoke spec.

groups.name: Sanity (all)
groups.description: Every sanity spec: smoke plus new-page coverage.

groups.name: Full E2E regression
groups.description: The whole Playwright suite under tests/e2e. Shard it.

groups.name: Functional (positive + negative)
groups.description: Both functional paths in one run.

groups.name: API contract governance
groups.description: Contract governance plus the OpenAPI response-schema check.

groups.name: React surface
groups.description: Every spec covering the React app under /app.

groups.name: Agent scenarios
groups.description: Healing, diagnosis, policy, RBAC, and orchestration scenarios.

groups.name: Unit (Vitest)
groups.description: React component and helper unit tests. No browser, no app server.
